purpose: W1 PAiD source qualification and one new deterministic closed-loop CPU PhysX tracking baseline. Backend is SAPIEN PhysxCpuSystem, independent of the Isaac GPU runtime.
selection: First numbered standard reference by filename, one trial, no seed sweep or residual controls. Fixed historical scene from configs/targeted_shooting_v1.json.
post_clip_reference: hold last available frame through 14 s with ONNX recurrent state continuous
initial_state: Use raw frame0 root pose, body linear/angular velocity and joint q/dq once; stationary ball. Ground is infinite plane at z=0.
controller: Released ONNX CPU only, zero initial h,c and previous action, 29 named position setpoints from exported default/scale. No fine-tuning, artificial ball impulses or mid-run state resets.
asset_conversion: Headless URDF strips visual tags, reproduces configured cylinder->capsule conversion, retaining radius/length/origin. Fixed links are kept by SAPIEN. Explicit stiffness/damping/armature mapped from upstream G1 drive groups; the exported ONNX metadata has rounded gains. URDF physical effort and velocity bounds and q limits enforced; qdot/position excess measured independently. No posthoc projection of the original PD targets.
reference_inventory: Validate all finite 50Hz T×29/T×30 fields, release asset SHA, side, named schema, FK position/orientation on every frame using original URDF and historical Isaac order; no body labels embedded in NPZ.
numerical_stop: Stop on nonfinite physical values; record physical threshold crossings and continue a finite trajectory for the prespecified full horizon, including post-failure states, no respawn.
tracking_metrics: 200 Hz linear interpolation of q,dq and world body position, 50 Hz endpoints exactly on source grid; report joint RMSE, source-root-aligned body geometry and world root error separately; body rotations/PX link measurements, loaded-foot contact-point material speed and ankle-origin horizontal speed distinguished.
physical_events: State interval indexed after native CPU step; first actual >2N right/any ball link, exported ball movement/goal, q/qdot limit exceedance, nonfoot >20N, root<0.45 or tilt>60deg; record full trace even if earlier falls. CPU contact normals are used only for endpoint-native loads, no original-USD instep surface certification.
success_scope: CPU source-tracking evidence only: report actual motion duration, fall, contact and measured tracking errors; no signed claim about USD safety, unseen motions, naturalness, or KineticMimic new actuation.
observer: Native actor and shape identifiers, world contact position/normal/impulse/separation, 200Hz post-step samples. Material-point slip uses post-step measured rigid twist at manifold position.
